request.prompt:
Goods: Cashew kernels W320, shelled
Country of origin: VN

Chosen so far: 08 Fruit and nuts, edible; peel of citrus fruit or melons

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 0801: Nuts, edible; coconuts, Brazil nuts and cashew nuts, fresh or dried, whether or not shelled or peeled
    contains 080132: Nuts, edible; cashew nuts, fresh or dried, shelled
    contains 080131: Nuts, edible; cashew nuts, fresh or dried, in shell
    contains 080112: Nuts, edible; coconuts, in the inner shell (endocarp)
    contains 080119: Nuts, edible; coconuts, fresh or dried, other than desiccated or in the inner shell (endocarp)
    contains 080122: Nuts, edible; brazil nuts, fresh or dried, shelled
    contains 080111: Nuts, edible; coconuts, desiccated
- 0802: Nuts (excluding coconuts, Brazils and cashew nuts); fresh or dried, whether or not shelled or peeled
    contains 080232: Nuts, edible; walnuts, fresh or dried, shelled
    contains 080231: Nuts, edible; walnuts, fresh or dried, in shell
    contains 080242: Nuts, edible; chestnuts (Castanea spp.), fresh or dried, shelled
    contains 080262: Nuts, edible; macadamia, fresh or dried, shelled

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Shelled cashew kernels are cashew nuts, fresh or dried, shelled, which fall under heading 0801 (subheading 080132), while 0802 expressly excludes cashew nuts.
